annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《康复辅助器具产业扩能提质三年行动方案（2026-2028年）》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Three-Year Action Plan for Expanding Capacity and Improving Quality of the Rehabilitation Assistive Devices Industry (2026-2028)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Civil Affairs of the People's Republic of China (民政部) et al.
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Civil Affairs notice (Min Han [2026] No. 48) issuing a 2026-2028 action plan for the rehabilitation assistive devices industry. It promotes key sub-sectors including brain-computer interfaces, rehabilitation and elderly-care robots and prostheses, and sets targets for industrial growth, R&D, standards and testing/certification capacity.
key_provisions_or_claims: Strengthen 6-8 key sub-industries including brain-computer interfaces, rehabilitation/elderly-care robots, prosthetics/orthotics and hearing aids
Make breakthroughs in 50 key technologies and develop at least 80 key products for health and elderly care
Aim for over 500 rehabilitation device enterprises above designated size and support listing/financing
Publish at least 60 standards and build a unified standards and regulatory system
Develop testing, inspection and certification bodies for assistive devices
